# bytes

Types from the Go package `bytes` (a library PocketBase builds on), as JavaScript sees them: they turn up as values of [PocketBase's types](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and of hook events.

## bytes.Reader

A Reader implements the [`io.reader`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/io#ioreader), `io.readerAt`, `io.writerTo`, `io.seeker`,
`io.byteScanner`, and `io.runeScanner` interfaces by reading from
a byte slice.
Unlike a `Buffer`, a Reader is read-only and supports seeking.
The zero value for Reader operates like a Reader of an empty slice.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `len()` | <code>(): number</code> | Len returns the number of bytes of the unread portion of the slice. |
| `size()` | <code>(): number</code> | Size returns the original length of the underlying byte slice. Size is the number of bytes available for reading via [`Reader.readAt`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/bytes#bytesreader). The result is unaffected by any method calls except [`Reader.reset`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/bytes#bytesreader). |
| `read()` | <code>(b: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): number</code> | Read implements the [`io.reader`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/io#ioreader) interface. |
| `readAt()` | <code>(b: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;, off: number): number</code> | ReadAt implements the `io.readerAt` interface. |
| `readByte()` | <code>(): number</code> | ReadByte implements the `io.byteReader` interface. |
| `unreadByte()` | <code>(): void</code> | UnreadByte complements [`Reader.readByte`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/bytes#bytesreader) in implementing the `io.byteScanner` interface. |
| `readRune()` | <code>(): [number, number]</code> | ReadRune implements the `io.runeReader` interface. |
| `unreadRune()` | <code>(): void</code> | UnreadRune complements [`Reader.readRune`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/bytes#bytesreader) in implementing the `io.runeScanner` interface. |
| `seek()` | <code>(offset: number, whence: number): number</code> | Seek implements the `io.seeker` interface. |
| `writeTo()` | <code>(w: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/io#iowriter">io.Writer</a>): number</code> | WriteTo implements the `io.writerTo` interface. |
| `reset()` | <code>(b: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): void</code> | Reset resets the [`Reader`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/bytes#bytesreader) to be reading from b. |
